name: Vitessce
description: Single-cell visual analytics for AnnData — embeddings, cell sets, heatmaps (Vitessce).

actions.name: computeUmap
actions.description: Compute a UMAP embedding for the opened .h5ad (cached; the file itself is not modified)

actions.name: toggleView
actions.description: Toggle one scatterplot embedding or one panel in the current view.

params.scatter: embedding type, for example UMAP or PCA; use instead of component
params.component: heatmap | obsSets | obsSetSizes | featureList | obsSetFeatureValueDistribution | featureValueHistogram | description | status; use instead of scatter

notes: Path-form backend (atrium stdio process) — runner supervision and placement.requires for the backend land in R2.
